ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: In the figure there are three groups of contour lines; near the inner closed line is marked a, the middle contour line is marked b, and the outer contour line is marked c; the question stem states a>b>c, so the values decrease from the inside to the outside. There is also a dashed line extending from the lower left to the upper right in the figure, passing through or approaching the high-value center and continuing to extend outward, showing an obvious linear corridor feature. Then reason: If these contour lines represent the level of urban land rent, then the land rent near a is the highest, and the land rent decreases outward to b and c. When industrial enterprises choose sites between the two lines b and c, the land rent level is roughly within the same grade belt; if they tend toward the location of the dashed line, it shows that it is not simply because the land rent is lower, but that the vicinity of the dashed line has additional locational advantages. Linear corridors in cities usually represent transport lines, and good transport accessibility attracts the layout of industrial enterprises. Therefore the most likely factor considered is transport.

method.method_draft: 先描述图像中 a、b、c 等值线由内向外递减的格局，再注意虚线是一条线状通道，穿过高值中心并向外延伸，使同一 b—c 地租带内虚线附近具有特殊区位优势。结合城市地租受交通可达性影响的规律，判断工业企业趋向虚线处不是因为地租更低，而是因为沿线交通便利。因此答案为交通。
method.CoT_raw:
先描述图像：图中有三组等值线，内侧闭合线附近标注 a，中间等值线标注 b，外侧等值线标注 c；题干说明 a>b>c，因此数值由内向外递减。图中还有一条由左下向右上延伸的虚线，穿过或接近高值中心，并继续向外延伸，呈明显的线状通道特征。
再推理：若这些等值线表示城市地租高低，则 a 附近地租最高，向外到 b、c 地租降低。工业企业在 b、c 两线之间选址时，地租水平大体处在同一等级带内；若它们趋向虚线所在地，说明不是单纯因为地租更低，而是虚线附近具有额外区位优势。城市中线状通道通常代表交通线路，交通可达性好会吸引工业企业布局。因此最可能考虑的因素是交通。
